resolution: All 6 findings reproduced and fixed. The tag was force-moved to the corrected commit (user decision).
severity_note: This review caught a PUBLISHED artifact being wrong. The tag had already been pushed when the red gate was found.

findings.claim: The roster omitted scripts/verify-scaffold.sh, which was RED at the published tag — so run-all-gates printed 'PASS — all 16 gates green' at a commit with a broken gate, and a tag was cut on that claim.
findings.evidence: At 23abd02: verify-scaffold.sh exits 1 with 'crate version 2.0.0-alpha.2 differs from manifest version 2.0.0-alpha.3'. CI runs it (scaffold-ci.yml:67); the roster did not.
findings.status: REPRODUCED — FIXED. Crate + lockfile bumped; ci/expected-tree.txt regenerated (additions only, zero removals); the hardcoded 'expected 29 companions' derived from templates/project-skills. Gate added to the roster. THE TAG WAS MOVED to the corrected commit.

findings.claim: The roster omitted scripts/test-opencode-plugin.mjs, a CI gate that can go red while all fast roster gates report PASS.
findings.evidence: production-convergence.yml:40 runs it; a mutation to the plugin makes it exit 1 while run-all-gates --fast still reported every gate PASS.
findings.status: REPRODUCED — FIXED. Added, along with the node --check syntax gate CI runs beside it.

findings.claim: No gate validated .codex-plugin/plugin.json or .agents/plugins/marketplace.json, so run-all-gates could report all-green with two of six published manifests carrying a bogus version — falsifying the tag message's 'all six manifests agree'.
findings.evidence: Setting both to 9.9.9-BOGUS left all 16 gates PASS. verify-skill-manifest.sh reads only three of the six.
findings.status: REPRODUCED — FIXED via the generated-drift gate (regenerate all four generators + git diff --exit-code), which covers every generated manifest. It immediately earned its place by catching this commit's own uncommitted Cargo.toml bump.

findings.claim: The roster omitted CI's generated-artifact drift check, so canonical artifacts could drift from their sources with run-all-gates green.
findings.evidence: production-convergence.yml:22-30 regenerates then runs git diff --exit-code; nothing equivalent was in the roster.
findings.status: REPRODUCED — FIXED. Added as the generated-drift gate.

findings.claim: D-3 said --fast skips 'the four slow gates' when the roster defined three.
findings.status: REPRODUCED — RESOLVED BY THE FIX. verify-scaffold was the missing fourth slow gate; the roster now has four and the prose is correct.

findings.claim: The roster covers two of audit.sh's six modes and omits `audit.sh all`, so no local gate exercises scaffolded-project layer contracts.
findings.evidence: scaffold-ci.yml:142 runs `audit.sh all` against a freshly scaffolded project; nothing local does.
findings.status: ACCEPTED, NOT FIXED. `audit.sh all` needs a scaffolded project to audit; verify-scaffold (now in the roster) builds one and audits it as part of its own run, so the surface is covered indirectly. A dedicated gate would duplicate a multi-minute scaffold. Recorded here rather than silently dropped.
